description: Generate a real free private Veteran REVIEW/DRAFT PDF from an explicitly selected saved review. Requires owner:read. Missing answers remain visible review questions; no VA connection is required. Supplemental answers remain reported and are not saved to the customer review. Optional connected VA facts require additional owner:va permission and explicit use for this applicant. Returns an expiring authenticated download of exact compiled bytes, not an official application, eligibility decision, savings estimate or filing.

use_connected_va_records.description: Only true when the user explicitly asks to use their connected records for their own applicant review; requires additional owner:va permission and is_surviving_spouse=false.

name: generate_veteran_packet
